title: Body encoding
summary: Use a UTF-8 file to send conversation and document bodies.
purpose: Use a UTF-8 file to send conversation and document bodies.

request.transport: Put the per-token probe below on the last line of the file. Read that file and send ASCII-escaped JSON. If supplying `body_chars` and `body_sha256`, compute them from that same file including the probe. For remote CLI, use the address and Bearer in the mention. Create the UTF-8 file in the current working directory and read it from a script. Keep the body and probe out of command-line arguments and console pipes.

response: A matching probe is removed before saving and bypasses the corruption heuristic.
errors: If the probe is broken, fix the transport and resend. Without a probe, a fingerprint mismatch or intentionally unchanged text can be accompanied by `force_encoding_reason` with at least 10 non-whitespace characters.
